character.name: Idle (copy)
character.prompt: Create a charming and memorable female young wizard character for a 2D pixel art platformer video game.  **CHARACTER DESIGN:** A small, adorable apprentice mage with a curious and adventurous personality.  - Small and slightly chibi proportions. - Large expressive eyes. - Short hair, slightly messy, with a few strands visible beneath her hat. - Oversized pointed wizard hat, slightly tilted, with a small crescent moon ornament. - Dark magical robe with lighter colored details. - Small cape flowing behind her. - A simple belt with a tiny magical pouch. - Holding a wooden magic staff with a glowing crystal at its tip. - Small boots suitable for an adventurous journey.  **ART STYLE:** - High-quality handcrafted pixel art. - Inspired by classic 16-bit RPG and platformer characters. - Distinctive silhouette, instantly recognizable. - Carefully placed highlights and shadows. - Consistent pixel clusters. - Limited but expressive color palette. - Crisp pixels, no anti-aliasing, no blur. - Beautiful details without excessive visual complexity.  **COLOR PALETTE:** - Deep purple and midnight blue for her clothing. - Lavender and violet highlights. - Soft golden details. - Cyan or light blue magical crystal. - Pale skin tones.  **POSE AND PRESENTATION:** - Full body character. - Standing in a neutral idle pose. - Facing three-quarters to the right. - Staff held naturally in one hand. - Feet clearly visible. - Entire character centered in the canvas. - Transparent background.  **TECHNICAL SPECIFICATIONS:** - Sprite design suitable for a 2D platformer. - Character proportions must remain consistent across future animation frames. - Clean silhouette for easy sprite separation. - No background, no scenery, no text, no UI. - No multiple characters. - No sprite sheet. - Single character illustration only.
